bounded_model.integer_domain: all amounts are integer atoms in [0, 2^256 - 1]
bounded_model.qualification_rule: exact roots match; all invalid, replay, safety, and recovery counters equal zero; every selected integer threshold is met

quote_cost_formula.onboarding: separate one-time cap with a separate budget

bounded_model.selection_rule: enumerate every required-winner combination for at most 16 candidates; enforce owner, failure-domain, recurring-budget, onboarding-budget, subject, asset, and epoch constraints; minimize recurring high-case cap, then onboarding cap, then sorted quote IDs
bounded_model.skin_in_the_game_rule: detection_probability_bps * slash_atoms + 10000 * future_value_lost_atoms >= 10000 * maximum_defect_gain_atoms; slash_atoms <= bond_atoms

bond_boundary_search.domain: defect gain, slash, future value lost=0..8 atoms; detection probability in {0,2500,5000,7500,10000} bps

external_qualification_context.observation: A signer tracks its last signed height, round, and type to prevent double signing; conflicting votes are evidence.
Validator key and last-sign-state custody are operator concerns; the default filesystem key path is not a qualified ZenoDEX profile.
The vendor publishes a per-Droplet monthly uptime SLA with exclusions; it does not establish end-to-end validator service qualification.
The published results are version- and hardware-specific and describe cycle rounding; current ZRPF pricing needs an exact current replay.
A receipt verifies execution of a specific program, so prover qualification must bind the exact image and journal profile.

payment_boundary.required_future_production_path: release-selected verifier -> opaque work witness -> current-head and purpose-budget recheck -> atomic ZenoLedger commit

procurement_flow: collect signed complete quote and beneficial-owner evidence
check bond and finite defect-gain inequality
exhaustively select the lowest feasible high-case portfolio
prefund selected recurring and onboarding caps in the payment asset
external verifier may later construct an opaque work witness
ZenoLedger must recheck current head, epoch, quote, job, period, and reserve caps
atomic commit may pay no more than verified liability and remaining reserve

promotion_boundary.claim: The research contract compares complete exact-subject quotes and returns a deterministic minimum-cost feasible set inside a bounded domain.
nonclaims: No real quote, qualification threshold, role count, or provider is selected.
Beneficial-owner and failure-domain evidence remains externally supplied.
The bond inequality depends on unselected defect-gain, detection, slash, and future-value inputs.
The finite selector does not establish unbounded optimality or Byzantine procurement security.
Vendor SLA and historical proof data do not qualify ZenoDEX end-to-end service.
Caller-constructible Python values are not opaque authority witnesses.
This artifact cannot admit work, move value, activate a role, or promote production.
